'''Storn''' is a human found in a cave within the [[Rogue Heights]] in [[Tirisfal Glades]]. The leader of a local bandit gang, [[Bounty Hunter Knox]] had been hunting him for a while. However, after having a falling out with his men, he went into hiding in the Tirisfal Uplands.

==Objective of==
* Drops [[Storn's Head]] for {{questlong|Horde|19|Bandit Lord}}
